timeline.role: UI/UX Architect / Senior Product Design & Front-End Lead
timeline.description: Lead UX architecture for complex telecom and enterprise applications — converting business, operational, and technical requirements into clear IA, workflows, interaction models, and production-ready UI specifications. Partner with product managers, domain experts, architects, developers, QA, and global stakeholders from discovery through release.
achievements: Delivered Nokia Enterprise Operations Portal for 2,500+ users across global delivery centres
Built automation tools reducing manual effort by up to 90%
Define reusable interaction patterns, responsive layouts, and design-system guidance improving consistency, scalability, and WCAG accessibility
Provide hands-on front-end architecture using Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, and API-driven UI patterns
Earned Nokia Excellence Award for Time Tracking & Cost Recharge workflow redesign
Led AI product portfolio: Telecom Support Copilot (secure RAG), AI UX Review Assistant, Smart Notification Rule Builder, Local Private AI Workspace
